color.note: Light grounds only. The first theme is the division; each product theme recolors field, field-ink, on-field and product-accent for that product's own page or section. Product colors also exist as named tokens in every theme, for pieces that show several products.

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: The ground of every page and slide. Never a dark background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: What matters: titles, lead lines, numbers, display type. 16:1 on white. Never pure black.

tokens.name: grey-text
tokens.usage: What supports: body, labels, tracker, footer. 7.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: product-backdrop
tokens.usage: Seamless ground behind product shots only; never a page background.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page and slide ground.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-page and on light fields.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-page.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Type on the bookend block and on silken-rose; large sizes only (24px and up).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Mint pairing, field: large shapes only (chapter number, tracker dash, color field). Ink type on it 7.7:1.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Mint pairing, ink: small colored type and the closing-line arrow. 4.2:1 on white, so 24px and up only.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sky pairing, field: large shapes only. Ink type on it 8.9:1.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Sky pairing, ink: small colored type and the closing-line arrow. 5.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Lavender pairing, field: large shapes only. Ink type on it 7.3:1.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Lavender pairing, ink: colored type and the arrow. 4.1:1 on white, so 24px and up only.

tokens.name: rose-gold
tokens.usage: Rose Gold pairing, field: large shapes only. Ink type on it 10:1. One of the only two allowed pinks.

tokens.name: rose-gold-ink
tokens.usage: Rose Gold pairing, ink (Silken Rose): colored type and the arrow. 3.8:1 on white, so 24px and up only.

tokens.name: silken-rose
tokens.usage: Silken Rose pairing, field: large shapes, with white caps at 24px and up (3.8:1). One of the only two allowed pinks.

tokens.name: silken-rose-ink
tokens.usage: Silken Rose pairing, ink: small colored type and the arrow. 6.2:1 on white.

tokens.name: bookend
tokens.usage: The opening and closing color block, with white type. Not a chapter pairing. White on it is 4.1:1: display, lead and wordmark pass; 18px labels fall short of 4.5:1, as in the source.

tokens.name: bookend-ink
tokens.usage: Type and wordmark on the bookend block.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The active field color: the one hero device per page. data-pairing on an element switches it to a chapter pairing; a product theme switches it to that product's field.

tokens.name: field-ink
tokens.usage: Small colored type and the closing-line arrow for the active pairing or product.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Type set on the active field color. White only on FoLix blue (5.9:1).

tokens.name: product-accent
tokens.usage: A product's second color, on its own page or section only. In the Aesthetics theme it falls back to rose-gold-ink and has no product meaning.

tokens.name: trilift-rose-gold
tokens.usage: triLift 2.0 highlight and field. Too light for text on white.

tokens.name: trilift-rose-gold-light
tokens.usage: triLift 2.0 gradient partner only, never a fill on its own.

tokens.name: trilift-shine-grey
tokens.usage: triLift 2.0 gradient partner to black only.

tokens.name: stellar-soft-rose-beige
tokens.usage: Stellar M22 primary and field (Soft Rose Beige = Rose Gold). Peach Beige #DEAA9B is never used.

tokens.name: stellar-silken-rose
tokens.usage: Stellar M22 primary; small colored type at 24px and up and the arrow (3.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: stellar-metallic-rose
tokens.usage: Stellar M22 device and handpiece branding only.

tokens.name: splendor-light-skin
tokens.usage: SPLENDOR X field. Ink type on it 10.3:1.

tokens.name: splendor-medium-skin
tokens.usage: SPLENDOR X second color.

tokens.name: splendor-dark-skin
tokens.usage: SPLENDOR X small colored type and the arrow. 7.4:1 on white.

tokens.name: splendor-vascular
tokens.usage: SPLENDOR X titles or subtitles only, to set vascular content apart. 3.4:1 on white, so 24px and up.

tokens.name: folix-turquoise
tokens.usage: FoLix highlight: highlighted words and small accents. Never a large fill. 2.3:1 on white, so never text on white.

tokens.name: folix-blue
tokens.usage: FoLix field, with white type (5.9:1); also small colored type on white.

tokens.name: folix-deep-blue
tokens.usage: FoLix gradient partner to turquoise.

tokens.name: ultrapulse-purple
tokens.usage: UltraPulse Alpha field and highlight. Ink type on it 7.1:1. The logo goes all white on it per the product guide (2.3:1). Never on the same page as the bookend purple.

tokens.name: ultrapulse-orchid
tokens.usage: UltraPulse Alpha: the second line of the double wave only.

tokens.name: verdict-winning
tokens.usage: Pill fill for a winning verdict, white text (5.2:1).

tokens.name: verdict-watch
tokens.usage: Pill fill for a watch verdict, ink text (8.9:1).

tokens.name: verdict-warning
tokens.usage: Pill fill for a warning verdict, white text at pill size falls short (3.8:1): keep the pill word short and in caps.

tokens.name: band-1
tokens.usage: Accelerate color band, stripe 1 of 19. The band is a signature strip on the opening only, never a palette to pick from.

tokens.usage: Accelerate color band, stripe 2.

styles.name: la-label
styles.usage: Labels: uppercase, letter-spaced, dark grey. 13 above the text it labels.

styles.name: la-body
styles.sample: Results patients can see, from doctors they trust.

styles.name: la-lead
styles.sample: We win when proof, the menu and the partner arrive together.
styles.usage: Lead line, quote and closing line, in Arizona Mix, ink.

styles.name: la-number
styles.usage: Supporting numbers in Arizona Sans Light. At most three beside a hero.

styles.name: la-display
styles.usage: Display: a name, a promise, the bookend line. Uppercase.

styles.name: la-chapter
styles.usage: Chapter number and single hero figures, in the field color.

styles.name: la-title
styles.usage: Slide title, uppercase, at top 149. One or two lines; no eyebrow above it.

styles.name: la-tracker
styles.usage: Tracker chapter name, uppercase, dark grey, at top 52.

styles.name: la-foot
styles.sample: Source: what we hear from owners, field themes.
styles.usage: Source note and page number in the footer, dark grey.

styles.name: la-pill
styles.usage: Pill and verdict text, uppercase, letter-spaced (0.12em).

spacing.note: Fibonacci steps only. These are the slide values; a smaller format may step each one down the sequence but never changes the order.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: A point and its supporting line.

tokens.name: space-13
tokens.usage: A label and the text it labels; a number and its label.

tokens.name: space-21
tokens.usage: A display line and the serif line that completes it; arrow to closing line.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Between groups; title to content, always.

tokens.name: space-55
tokens.usage: A serif lead line and the body it introduces; footer offset from the bottom.

tokens.name: space-89
tokens.usage: Bookend inset for the wordmark and headline; gap between stats.

tokens.name: space-144
tokens.usage: The largest step: generous separation on signature pages.

tokens.name: gap-tight
tokens.usage: Proximity: a point and its supporting line.

tokens.name: gap-near
tokens.usage: Proximity: a label and its text; a number and its label.

tokens.name: gap-follow
tokens.usage: Proximity: a display line and the serif line that completes it.

tokens.name: gap-apart
tokens.usage: Proximity: between groups; title to content.

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Proximity: a serif lead line and the body it introduces.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Photos, color blocks and fields: always square, always bleeding.

tokens.name: radius-dash
tokens.usage: Tracker dashes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills and verdicts: the only rounded element.

layout.note: The golden ratio sets every two-part split.

tokens.name: golden-major
tokens.usage: The larger part: text beside an image takes 61.8% of the content width; the bookend photo takes 61.8% of the format.

tokens.name: golden-minor
tokens.usage: The smaller part: a bleeding photo beside the text column; the bookend color block.

slide.note: Fixed frame of the 16:9 slide format, in slide pixels. Every slide uses the same values.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Canvas width.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Canvas height.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Side margin.

tokens.name: slide-column
tokens.usage: Text column: x 128–1101 beside a right-hand photo, x 819–1792 beside a left-hand photo.

tokens.name: slide-column-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the text column and a bleeding photo.

tokens.name: slide-bleed-major
tokens.usage: Bookend photo width (61.8% of 1920).

tokens.name: slide-bleed-minor
tokens.usage: Photo or color block beside the text column (38.2% of 1920).

tokens.name: slide-tracker-top
tokens.usage: Tracker, from the top edge.

tokens.name: slide-title-top
tokens.usage: Title, from the top edge.

tokens.name: slide-content-bottom
tokens.usage: Content bottom: the closing line ends here, so a second line grows upward.

tokens.name: slide-footer-bottom
tokens.usage: Footer, from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: slide-footer-logo
tokens.usage: Footer wordmark width (about 18 tall).

tokens.name: slide-bookend-logo
tokens.usage: Wordmark width on the bookend block.
